name: Hot Tub
subtitle: Porn Without the Pop-Ups.
description:
Hot Tub is an elegant, native porn app. Thoughtfully designed, ethically made, and free to use.

✨ Key Features

📱 iOS native
The first porn app on iOS

👤 No account needed
Just install and start watching

🎬 Tabbed browsing
Open multiple videos like browser tabs

❤️ Favorites
Save videos you love

📺 Watch history
Track what you've watched

🔐 Private & secure
Privacy-first: anonymous analytics, never linked to your account. Optional sharing is off by default. Not sold to advertisers.

🔒 Face/Touch ID
Lock the app with biometric security

🔊 Speaker warnings
Get notified when connected to Bluetooth speakers

🎛️ Filters & blocks
Hide performers, block keywords, and more

🔎 Advanced search
Find exactly what you want

🌐 Multi-network
Access multiple video sources

🚫 Minimal interruptions
Clean experience without intrusive ads

🌈 LGBTQ+ Friendly
Inclusive content preferences

🎨 Customizable
Tons of options to customize your experience

🔌 Open API
Create and host your own sources


Why Hot Tub?
Because porn websites are frustrating.

🌀 Redirect hell.
🤖 Data brokers stalking your clicks.
🎯 Aggressive pop-ups.
📱 Mobile sites that barely work.

Sound familiar?

We wanted something better. So we built Hot Tub: a sleek, native iOS app that's clean, private, and easy to use.

Just you, your queue, and the content you actually want to see.

🛠 What Makes Hot Tub Special?
🛋 Built for Comfort.
Swipe between videos, open multiple tabs, intuitive gestures that just feels right.

🔒 Lock It Down.
Your privacy is our priority. With a built in privacy screen, Face/Touch ID, and customizable controls, Hot Tub keeps things private when it matters most.

✨ Advanced Search (Hot Tub Pro — Subscribers Only).
Looking for something specific? With Hot Tub Pro, unlock advanced search, filtering, and categories across multiple networks — because sometimes you really know what you're in the mood for.

🔊 Output device notifications
Get notifications when you're accidentally connected to that bluetooth speaker... No more embarrassing moments.

📱 Designed for iOS 15-18.
Hot Tub is a fully native iOS app — no hacks, no shortcuts, no sketchy installs. Just smooth, native performance that works exactly how you'd expect.

"Why not just use [Pornsite Name]?
Let's be real: Websites kinda suck.

They're clunky, cluttered, and constantly trying to sell you junk you don't need.
We've all been there:

👀 You're browsing.
👆 You're about to click.
💥 BAM — the page moves.
🔄 You're stuck in pop-up hell! An endless loop of fake giveaways and sketchy redirects. (Sorry, no, you didn't actually win a free tablet.)

With Hot Tub, you get a clean, focused experience.
No sketchy redirects. No intrusive pop-ups. No data harvesting.

Just you, a clean interface, and the content you actually want.

How Is It Free?
Simple. Hot Tub is funded by our community.

We don't sell your data. Privacy-first: limited telemetry and anonymous analytics, not tied to your identity; opt out in settings where available.
Hot Tub stays free thanks to:

💙 Supporters
🌟 Hot Tub Pro Members (who unlock extra features)
🎁 Donations from people like you.

We believe porn should feel good — not shady.
Clean experience. Respectful monetization. Just better.

Take a Dip.
✅ Browse popular, categories, or search.
✅ Tap videos to open them in new tabs.
✅ Swipe between your open videos, save your favorites.
✅ Close the app, and lock it down.

Clean experience.
No nonsense.
Just Hot Tub — your private, cozy corner of the internet.

The water is warm. Download Hot Tub and take a dip.
Your new favorite app is waiting.

versions.localizedDescription:
- Added Portuguese localization and improved in-app language switching.
- Added a new Ideas Hub with separate Features and Channels areas, channel search, and easier voting/request flows.
- Added activation-code deep links and a cleaner redeem flow across Settings and paywalls.
- Improved Vault organization with notes, tags, search, and people management.
- Improved Discover and Tapes playback reliability, especially after scrubbing, tab changes, and inline-to-fullscreen transitions.
- Improved video playback diagnostics so support reports include more useful troubleshooting details.
- Added richer interactive in-app HTML content support for embedded cards and fundraising messages.
- Fixed multiple playback edge cases around looping, Picture in Picture, previews, cache routing, and resume behavior.
- Fixed localization and string display issues across Settings, Vault, video errors, reports, and common time labels.

privacy.NSCameraUsageDescription: This app needs access to your camera to capture photos and videos for your vault.
privacy.NSFaceIDUsageDescription: FaceID is used to prevent unauthorized access to the app.
privacy.NSMotionUsageDescription: This app uses motion sensors to enhance visual effects and detect shake gestures for the debug menu.
privacy.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: This app needs access to your microphone to record audio with videos for your vault.
privacy.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Hot Tub needs access to your photo library to scan for sensitive content. Scanning is done only on your device; nothing is uploaded.

versions.localizedDescription:
- Fix card disappearing
- Improve PIP responsiveness
- Preliminary download support
- Fix playlist card layout
- Local playback histograms (support for upcoming features)
- Improve playback support for direct URLs
- In App Purchases entitlements bug fixes & improvements
- Improve audio normalization processing
- Fix uploader follow button
- Animate removal of player tabs
- Fix player controls safe area layout
- Fix searches not updating
- Fix tags in Tapes
- Improve flexible API model decoding + serialization
- Optimize startup/launch times
- Optimize performance for improved device thermals + battery life
- Fix search term completion/suggestions missing a space
- Fix swipe up gesture area on media player bar
- Fix autoplay toggle switch—don’t auto play previews when disabled.
- Added the ability to select text from video titles
- Added Urban Dictionary lookup in text selection
- Support for AirPlay in the custom Hot Tub player, deprecating the system player for maintainability (if the Hot Tub player is missing any features pl let me know)
- Improve support for CDNs with AES-128 encrypted streams
- Fix filter pickers on iOS 15 + 16
- New icon
